name: mirage
text: Built and released. v1.0.28: https://github.com/tjshea90/novig/releases/tag/v1.0.28 . The engine now runs a full scan, then quick scans of the next 48 h for 15 minutes (a fifth of the Novig books, so near games' fair odds and prices are minutes old, not 13), then a full scan again. Far games stay in the list from the last full scan with their own real ages; bids on far games stay up. The engine picks this up at its next handover or restart. v1.0.27 (ParlayAPI Pro in the hot refresh) is out too. Next I'll check the first quick-scan timings in the engine log.
